info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v3-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Classes Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of fitness classes available under various membership options. This endpoint serves fitness service providers looking to display the classes they offer to potential members, as well as existing members wanting to explore their options. Users can retrieve detailed information about each class, including schedules, instructors, and membership requirements. This API is instrumental for gym operators and application developers aiming to enhance member engagement and streamline class management.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of membership classes.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all available membership classes. You can use this to display membership options to users or to facilitate the membership purchase process.
